title: BOYS LOVE
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Magazine editor Taishin Mamiya interviews Noeru Kisaragi, a popular teen model still in high school. Noeru makes a sexual advance that Mamiya refuses, but Mamiya's loneliness draws him back, and the two form a deep bond that Noeru's childhood friend Chidori complicates. The manga adapts a Japanese film of the same title and is labelled a tragedy (AniList, MU, Comic Book Bin).
life_message: Love and loneliness are shown as powerful enough to override social limits, at a tragic cost.
